signature: SUBROUTINE ZHBGVX( JOBZ, RANGE, UPLO, N, KA, KB, AB, LDAB, BB,

params.name: jobz
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
-   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

params.name: range
uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangles of A and B are stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangles of A and B are stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ka
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KA} \ge 0$.

params.name: kb
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix B if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KB} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian band matrix A, stored in the first ka+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(ka+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{ka}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{ka})$.

On exit, the contents of `AB` are destroyed.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KA}+1$.

params.name: BB
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian band matrix B, stored in the first kb+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of B is stored in the j-th column of the array `BB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `BB(kb+1+i-j,j) = B(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kb}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `BB(1+i-j,j) = B(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kb})$.

On exit, the factor S from the split Cholesky factorization $B = S^H \, S$, as returned by ZPBSTF.

params.name: ldbb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `BB`. $\mathrm{LDBB} \ge \mathrm{KB}+1$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, the n-by-n matrix used in the reduction of $A \, x = (\lambda ) \, B \, x$ to standard form, i.e. $C \, x = (\lambda ) \, x$, and consequently C to tridiagonal form. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, the array Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$. If `JOBZ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: vl
params.reference: If `RANGE='V'`, the lower bound of the interval to be searched for eigenvalues. $\mathrm{VL} < \mathrm{VU}$. Not referenced if `RANGE = 'A'` or 'I'.

params.name: vu
params.reference: If `RANGE='V'`, the upper bound of the interval to be searched for eigenvalues. $\mathrm{VL} < \mathrm{VU}$. Not referenced if `RANGE = 'A'` or 'I'.

params.name: il
params.reference: If `RANGE='I'`, the index of the smallest eigenvalue to be returned. $1 \le \mathrm{IL} \le \mathrm{IU} \le N$, if $N > 0$; `IL = 1` and `IU = 0` if $N = 0$. Not referenced if `RANGE = 'A'` or 'V'.

params.name: iu
params.reference: If `RANGE='I'`, the index of the largest eigenvalue to be returned. $1 \le \mathrm{IL} \le \mathrm{IU} \le N$, if $N > 0$; `IL = 1` and `IU = 0` if $N = 0$. Not referenced if `RANGE = 'A'` or 'V'.

params.name: abstol
params.reference:
The absolute error tolerance for the eigenvalues. An approximate eigenvalue is accepted as converged when it is determined to lie in an interval \[a,b\] of width less than or equal to

$$
\mathrm{ABSTOL} + \mathrm{EPS} \, \max ( |a|,|b| )
$$

where EPS is the machine precision. If `ABSTOL` is less than or equal to zero, then EPS\*\|T\| will be used in its place, where \|T\| is the 1-norm of the tridiagonal matrix obtained by reducing AP to tridiagonal form.

Eigenvalues will be computed most accurately when `ABSTOL` is set to twice the underflow threshold $2 \, \mathrm{DLAMCH}(\text{'S'})$, not zero. If this routine returns with $\mathrm{INFO}>0$, indicating that some eigenvectors did not converge, try setting `ABSTOL` to $2 \, \mathrm{DLAMCH}(\text{'S'})$.

params.name: m
params.reference: The total number of eigenvalues found. $0 \le M \le N$. If `RANGE = 'A'`, $M = N$, and if `RANGE = 'I'`, $M = \mathrm{IU}-\mathrm{IL}+1$.

params.name: w
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the matrix Z of eigenvectors, with the i-th column of Z holding the eigenvector associated with `W(i)`. The eigenvectors are normalized so that $Z^H \, B \, Z = I$. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$, and if `JOBZ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge N$.

params.name: IFAIL
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, the first M elements of `IFAIL` are zero. If $\mathrm{INFO} > 0$, then `IFAIL` contains the indices of the eigenvectors that failed to converge. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then `IFAIL` is not referenced.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, and i is: \<= N:  then i eigenvectors failed to converge.  Their indices are stored in array `IFAIL`.
-   `> N`: if $\mathrm{INFO} = N + i$, for $1 \le i \le N$, then ZPBSTF returned `INFO = i`: B is not positive definite. The factorization of B could not be completed and no eigenvalues or eigenvectors were computed.

checks.js: range !== 'value' && range === 'index' && (iu < min( N, il ) || iu > N)
